title: Dar Global Overview, Heritage & Global Operations
content: Dar Global PLC (LSE: DAR) is a London-listed premier international luxury real estate investment and development company. Backed by a 32-year track record via parent company Dar Al Arkan, Dar Global has developed a Gross Development Value (GDV) of over $23 billion. It operates across 7 international markets: United Arab Emirates (Dubai), Saudi Arabia (Riyadh), Qatar, Oman (Muscat), Spain (Costa del Sol / Benahavís), United Kingdom (London), and the Maldives. Dar Global caters to luxury investors from over 125 nationalities and is celebrated for co-branding developments with iconic global luxury fashion and automotive powerhouses including Pagani, Missoni, Versace, Automobili Lamborghini, Dolce & Gabbana, Fendi Casa, and Trump International.

title: Dar Global HY 2026 Financial Results and Expansion
content: Dar Global announced its unaudited interim financial results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), posting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (compared to US$155.4 million in HY 2025). The company's total portfolio Gross Development Value (GDV) expanded to $23 billion. Dar Global has demonstrated disciplined financial execution, robust cash flow generation, and strong demand across its flagship master developments in Oman, Qatar, Dubai, and Spain.

title: AIDA Mixed-Use Clifftop Community in Muscat, Oman
content: AIDA is one of the world's most prestigious premium mixed-use real estate communities, situated on cliffs perched 130 meters above the Gulf of Oman in Muscat, Oman. Spanning over 3.5 million square meters, AIDA combines dramatic oceanfront cliffs, secluded beaches, and natural topography. Key features include the Trump International Golf Club Oman with an 18-hole championship course, ultra-luxury residential villas, five-star hospitality suites, and the Azure Oceanfront Villas featuring haute couture interior design crafted exclusively by FENDI Casa.

title: Trump International Golf Club & Trump Villas, Simaisma, Qatar
content: Trump International Golf Club Simaisma is an ultra-exclusive coastal resort destination in Qatar developed by Dar Global. The development launched official sales for the Trump Villas in October 2026, receiving unprecedented international investor demand. The master community features an 18-hole signature championship golf course, private luxury villas with private beach access, branded hospitality, fine dining, and elite wellness clubs.

title: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
content: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is an iconic luxury high-rise development in Dubai developed by Dar Global. Construction contracts for the podium were awarded to Gulf Asia Contracting following the completion of enabling works in September 2026. The tower integrates high-end hotel suites, exclusive residential apartments, panoramic Dubai skyline views, and bespoke Trump hospitality and concierge services.

title: Trump International Hotel & Resort Maldives (Noonu Atoll)
content: Located in the secluded and pristine waters of Noonu Atoll in the Maldives, Trump International Hotel & Resort Maldives is Dar Global's flagship private island resort. It offers ultra-luxurious overwater villas, beachfront estates, private yacht moorings, Michelin-caliber dining, and an exclusive marine wellness spa.

title: Rayana Master Community in Wadi Safar, Diriyah, Riyadh
content: Rayana is an ultra-exclusive master community developed by Dar Global in Wadi Safar, Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. In June 2026, Dar Global awarded a SAR 338 million master community infrastructure contract to Compass and Bin Omairah Company for Contracting LLC. Rayana reflects authentic Najdi architectural heritage combined with modern sustainable luxury, equestrian facilities, and championship golf access.

title: Tierra Viva by Automobili Lamborghini in Benahavís, Spain
content: Tierra Viva is an exclusive gated community of ultra-luxury villas located in Benahavís, Costa del Sol, Spain, overlooking the Mediterranean Sea. The project represents Dar Global's collaboration with Italian supercar icon Automobili Lamborghini. The villas feature aerodynamic architectural geometry, sharp angular layouts inspired by Lamborghini supercars, infinity pools, and panoramic mountain-to-sea vistas.

title: Urban Oasis by Missoni in Business Bay, Dubai
content: Urban Oasis is a 34-story waterfront residential tower by Dar Global situated on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay, Dubai. The tower features custom interiors designed by iconic Italian fashion house Missoni, blending vibrant colors, zigzag patterns, bespoke penthouse duplexes, and private waterfront infinity pool decks.

title: Da Vinci Tower by Pagani in Downtown Dubai
content: Da Vinci Tower is an ultra-exclusive residential building situated along the Dubai Canal in Downtown Dubai, created by Dar Global in partnership with hypercar manufacturer Pagani Automobili. The tower reflects Horacio Pagani's philosophy of combining art and science, featuring carbon-fiber detailing, tailor-made luxury furnishings, and sweeping views of Burj Khalifa.

title: Wasalt Saudi Real Estate Platform Overview & Value Proposition
content: Wasalt (wasalt.sa) is Saudi Arabia's leading PropTech digital marketplace and real estate technology platform, operating under the Quara Holding and Dar Al Arkan ecosystem. Wasalt connects property buyers, tenants, brokers, real estate agencies, and property developers across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. With thousands of verified listings in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Khobar, Mecca, Medina, and Taif, Wasalt empowers consumers to search, compare, evaluate, and finance residential and commercial properties seamlessly online.

title: Wasalt Property Search, Property Types & Map Discovery
content:
Wasalt provides an interactive search engine and map-based interface allowing users to filter properties across Saudi Arabia by exact neighborhood, price range, property type, area (square meters), bedrooms, and amenities. Supported property types include:
1. Residential: Villas, apartments, duplexes, floor units, residential lands, townhouses, and chalets.
2. Commercial: Commercial lands, office buildings, retail showrooms, warehouses, and compounds.
Both properties for sale and properties for rent (annual or monthly) are fully supported with photo galleries, virtual tours, and direct broker contact links.

title: REGA Compliance, Fal Broker Licensing & Ejar Integration
content: Wasalt strictly adheres to the regulations established by the Saudi Real Estate General Authority (REGA - الهيئة العامة للعقار). All property advertisements on Wasalt require authenticated licensing (Fal Broker License - رخصة فال) and advertisement verification numbers to prevent deceptive or fraudulent listings. Furthermore, Wasalt integrates rental workflows in compliance with the Ministry of Housing's Ejar platform to ensure unified, legally protected tenancy contracts.

title: Wasalt Business Portal for Brokers, Agencies & Developers
content: Wasalt Business (wasalt.sa/en/s/wasalt-business) is a dedicated enterprise and SaaS portal for real estate brokers, marketing agencies, and real estate developers in Saudi Arabia. It provides advanced lead management, automated listing syndication, analytics on buyer views and inquiries, CRM tools, campaign advertising packages, and compliance verification management.

title: Wasalt Property Valuation, Price Indices & Mortgage Calculator
content:
Wasalt provides proprietary digital real estate tools to aid financial decision-making in the Saudi market:
1. Property Valuation & Price Index: Uses real-time and historical transaction data to give users accurate per-square-meter valuations for properties across specific districts in Riyadh, Jeddah, and the Eastern Province.
2. Mortgage & Financing Calculator: Enables prospective homebuyers to compute expected monthly loan installments, maximum debt burdens, down-payment ratios, and APR estimates in coordination with licensed Saudi financial institutions and commercial banks.

title: Wasalt Real Estate Auctions and Digital E-Wallet
content: Wasalt hosts digital real estate auctions across Saudi Arabia for prime government and commercial properties, large land parcels, and distressed assets. Users register with verified Saudi national ID / Iqama credentials, deposit bidding guarantees securely via an integrated e-wallet (Terms for E-Wallet), and participate in transparent real-time bidding rounds supervised in compliance with Saudi commercial and judicial auction laws.

title: Relationship Between Dar Global, Wasalt & Dar Al Arkan
content: Dar Global and Wasalt share a close strategic synergy within the renowned Saudi real estate ecosystem. Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company (listed on Tadawul: 4300) is the leading real estate developer in Saudi Arabia with over three decades of building major master communities. Dar Global was established as the international luxury arm of Dar Al Arkan, publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: DAR), focusing on premier branded residences globally. Wasalt is the PropTech and digital brokerage vehicle developed within the Quara Holding / Dar Al Arkan sphere to revolutionize property transactions, financing, and broker ecosystems across Saudi Arabia.
